deviations.what: the authority lattice encoded is STRICTER than the spec states: c15/c29 say the worker may write senses knowledge but never senses prompts; t3 encoded the full (origin, target) matrix so the worker owns exactly senses.knowledge and nothing else - it also cannot write worker.tools, worker.permissions, worker.prompts or senses.permissions
deviations.reason: a seat that can widen its own tool surface is the escalation h11 exists to prevent, and a lattice granting more than the operator stated would be minting authority; stricter than the letter of an operator decision is still a divergence from it, so it is recorded rather than absorbed

deviations.what: a third origin 'host' was added, not present in the spec's two-origin (strategist, worker) model
deviations.reason: without it t6's revert-to-baseline must be a privileged back door around the lattice; with it, revert is an ordinary change unit the ledger records like any other - which is what c8's every-transition-recorded requirement wants

deviations.what: t5 re-declared a structurally identical ConfigPersistence port instead of importing scoped_run.ScopePersistence, which the plan's acceptance criterion named
deviations.reason: importing the advisory lane would create the import edge config_change.py's TestCitedNotCoupled exists to forbid - an import edge is a reason to edit the advisory lane, and it must stay byte-stable as t13's comparator; a test proves the two types share the same field set

deviations.what: ConfigDeferral deliberately does NOT subclass ConfigDegradation, breaking t3's one-degradation-stream-folds shape; it carries the same field names and to_dict keys but lands in a separate deferrals stream
deviations.reason: a busy seat is the gate WORKING - folding it into degradations would make a correct session report hundreds of them, and a count that rises during normal operation is a count nobody reads; nothing is dropped

deviations.what: a verified -> proposed demotion transition exists, which is not in the spec's five-kind event vocabulary (proposed/validated/applied/rejected/reverted)
deviations.reason: t5's config_events has no kind for it; either a sixth kind or a documented mapping is needed - t9 (the composition task) is where this must be resolved or it becomes an unrepresentable state

deviations.what: t7's report derives 'gate verdict' as the ledger's applied/reverted vocabulary, not c32's richer passed/failed/stale - it deliberately refuses to read config_lifecycle.ConfigTransition.verdict because that would be the 'gap filled from elsewhere' h22 forbids
deviations.reason: the honest fix is for the LEDGER to record the verdict at write time so the report can derive it from one source; today it does not, so the report makes the weaker claim rather than a richer unfounded one - resolvable in t9 composition or a follow-up to t5

deviations.what: t6's revert cannot restore a prompt section or knowledge entry to true non-existence: config_lifecycle's apply primitives are additive (a section clears to empty but never leaves the tuple; KnowledgeChange requires non-blank text)
deviations.reason: made observable rather than silent - RevertOutcome.residual_prompt_sections/residual_knowledge_entries name what is left and matches_baseline reads False, so exact restoration is never falsely claimed; composed prompt behaviour still matches baseline because compose_prompt filters empty sections

deviations.what: the cycle-2 config arms (A4/A5) are declared in the hermetic scaffold but scopebench_live.py's LIVE_ARMS is still (A2, A3), so the arm under test cannot be dialled - t13 could not fix this because the live harness deliberately lives outside examples/scope/ to keep that folder hermetic, and its brief scoped it to examples/scope/
deviations.reason: an unnoticed consequence of the hermetic/live split the pre-registration itself enforces; t14 cannot run without extending the live harness, so the extension is done as part of t14 rather than left as a silent blocker

deviations.what: condition 8's restore clause will read FAILED on a digest rather than on drift: the shipped lane restores the seat's prompt BYTES exactly (compose_prompt filters empty sections) but not config_sha, because a cleared prompt section stays declared (deviation d7's additive-only primitive)
deviations.reason: DECISION: the pre-registration is NOT amended, even though section 19 permits it before any committed record exists. Moving a threshold to fit a known outcome is what makes a pre-registration worthless. The series runs under the committed rule and the report states the digest artifact beside the verdict, with compose_prompt_restored measuring functional restoration. Amending is a cycle-3 decision made with evidence in hand, not a pre-emptive one
